purpose: Versioned proposal for a constrained Aurora coding-agent integration with the canonical ATCLang compiler/toolchain. This contract does not claim an implemented adapter or passing tests.

authority.control_plane_scope: Architecture, ownership, integration contracts and evidence only; no compiler or adapter implementation is duplicated here.

source_inventory.rule: Blob SHAs below identify inspected files only. They are not repository HEAD SHAs. Capture the exact commit SHA and tree SHA for each repository before claiming source inventory completion.

inspected_sources.finding: Declares Rust-only active implementation path; canonical core is crates/atc-core; documents atc compile, atc check and atc run. Current release/production readiness is not established by README.

Defines specs as normative source of truth and documents Rust-first baseline; parts of this architecture document also describe historical Python reference structure and must not be treated as active implementation evidence.
Describes the repository as an R1 skeleton; CLI implementation and tests follow with implementation. Do not assume a production CLI adapter exists.
agent_runtime.atc, tool_executor.atc and sandbox are explicitly PLANNED; request/response interfaces are unspecified.

required_follow_up: Record exact commit HEAD and tree SHA for atclang, atc-toolchain and aurora-ai.
Enumerate normative grammar/type/semantic specifications under atclang/specs and bind each relevant file to its blob SHA.
Locate and inspect active Rust frontend/parser/type-checker/compiler/verifier modules under crates/atc-core; exclude historical Python/reference code from canonical runtime mapping.
Inspect CLI command dispatch, argument parsing, diagnostics and actual process exit-code behavior.
Inventory conformance, syntax-error, type-error, malformed-input, resource-limit and differential tests with exact paths/blob SHAs.
Confirm the real compiler invocation and machine-readable diagnostic support from source and tests before adapter implementation.

compatibility.language_version: MUST be explicitly selected from the canonical atclang specs; never infer from prose or use an unpinned latest version.
compatibility.toolchain_identity: MUST include repository, exact commit SHA, executable/build digest and selected language/spec version.
compatibility.unknown_versions: REJECT unless an explicit compatibility policy allows them.

required_fields.source: ATCLang source text, UTF-8, bounded by policy-configured byte limit.
required_fields.toolchain: Repository, exact commit SHA, build/executable digest, and requested command.
required_fields.operation: check | compile; run is disabled by default and requires a separate explicit execution policy.

limits.timeout_ms: Positive bounded integer, capped by service policy.
limits.max_source_bytes: Positive bounded integer, capped by service policy.
limits.max_output_bytes: Positive bounded integer, capped by service policy.
limits.max_memory_bytes: Positive bounded integer when enforceable by the sandbox.

required_fields.capability_profile: Named, allowlisted profile; no ambient capabilities.
required_fields.idempotency_key: Required for retried requests; scoped to caller and request semantics.

forbidden_inputs: Untrusted shell fragments or command-line concatenation.
Arbitrary executable paths, dynamic library paths or toolchain installation commands.
Credentials, environment passthrough, unrestricted filesystem paths or unrestricted network requests.
Implicit language/toolchain versions or an unbounded timeout.

rules: Diagnostics are data, never executable instructions.
Do not fabricate source spans or diagnostic codes absent from compiler output.
If the compiler does not expose structured diagnostics, preserve raw output and mark structured fields unknown.
Redact secrets and policy-sensitive paths from logs; never log source contents by default.
A response with truncated diagnostics must set truncated=true.

exit_code_mapping.rule: These are Aurora adapter-normalized codes, not a claim about current atclang CLI exit codes. Preserve raw_tool_exit_code separately. Final mapping must be reconciled against exact-SHA CLI source and tests.

errors_and_lifecycle: Fail closed if source validation, toolchain identity, version compatibility, policy checks or capability checks fail.
On timeout or cancellation, terminate the complete process group/container and reap child processes; do not return success for partial output.
Retries are allowed only for explicitly retryable infrastructure failures and must preserve idempotency semantics.
Never automatically apply generated code or compiler-driven corrections to a repository.
Correction suggestions are untrusted proposals; each revision must be revalidated from scratch.
Separate compiler diagnostics from model-authored explanations.

coding_agent_workflow.name: INTENT_TO_SPEC
coding_agent_workflow.action: Convert user intent into a bounded change proposal and explicit acceptance criteria.

coding_agent_workflow.name: GENERATE
coding_agent_workflow.action: Generate ATCLang source against the pinned canonical language version; do not invent grammar or standard-library APIs.

coding_agent_workflow.name: STATIC_POLICY_CHECK
coding_agent_workflow.action: Check request size, allowed paths, capabilities and forbidden operations before invoking the toolchain.

coding_agent_workflow.name: CHECK
coding_agent_workflow.action: Invoke the canonical check/validation entry point through an argument-safe adapter in an isolated worker.

coding_agent_workflow.name: DIAGNOSE
coding_agent_workflow.action: Parse or preserve toolchain diagnostics and bind them to the exact source revision and toolchain SHA.

coding_agent_workflow.name: PROPOSE_CORRECTION
coding_agent_workflow.action: Propose a bounded correction; do not apply it automatically to the user's repository.

coding_agent_workflow.name: REVALIDATE
coding_agent_workflow.action: Re-run policy and compiler checks on the complete revised source; cap correction iterations.

coding_agent_workflow.name: HUMAN_APPROVAL
coding_agent_workflow.action: Require explicit approval before writing files, creating commits, opening PRs, or invoking consequential tools.

coding_agent_workflow.name: EVIDENCE
coding_agent_workflow.action: Record exact source/toolchain SHAs and Run-ID → Job-ID → Step-ID → exit code/log references.

security.execution: Use an ephemeral isolated worker/container with non-root identity, read-only toolchain mount, temporary bounded workspace, CPU/memory/process/file-size limits and mandatory timeout.
security.filesystem: No repository write access during generation/check/compile. Only explicitly staged source files may be mounted; no host home, SSH keys, credentials or arbitrary workspace paths.
security.network: Deny by default; no network egress during compile/check unless separately approved and documented.
security.authority: Aurora model output is a proposal, not authorization. Enforce policy and capability checks outside the model.
security.side_effects: No file mutation, commit, push, deployment, chain operation or external publication without explicit user approval.
security.deterministic_boundary: The coding agent must not change consensus rules, canonical ATC-VM semantics, kernel authority or governance decisions.

acceptance_tests.expected: VALID only if canonical checker exits successfully for the pinned toolchain; otherwise preserve the observed diagnostic/status.
Non-success result, syntax diagnostic preserved, no output artifact accepted as valid.
Non-success result, type diagnostic preserved, no output artifact accepted as valid.
Reject before tool invocation; no crash and no unbounded allocation.
Worker and child processes terminated; status is TIMEOUT or CANCELLED, never VALID.
No compiler or mutating tool invocation occurs after denial.
Fail closed with TOOLCHAIN_UNAVAILABLE or compatibility rejection and exact evidence.
Bounded iterations; every revision rechecked; never auto-write or auto-commit.
Exact commit SHA, Run-ID, Job-ID, Step-ID, exit code and log reference required; missing values remain RESIDUAL.

release_gates: Complete exact-HEAD source inventory for canonical grammar/specs, Rust parser/frontend, type checker, compiler/verifier, CLI, diagnostics and tests.
Resolve actual CLI exit-code and structured-diagnostic behavior from implementation and tests; do not treat proposed normalized codes as observed behavior.
Implement adapter only in the canonical Aurora runtime owner repository, after contract review.
Add unit, integration, negative, security and reproducibility tests.
Demonstrate each required case on an exact SHA with Run-ID → Job-ID → Step-ID → exit code/log evidence.
Keep implementation status IMPLEMENTATION_PENDING until adapter and tests exist; keep verification NOT_RUN until evidence is reviewed.
residuals: No Aurora ATCLang adapter implementation verified.
Aurora runtime tool executor and sandbox are marked PLANNED in the inspected component plan.
ATC Toolchain README describes an R1 skeleton; its production CLI and test support for this use case are not verified.
Normative specs, active Rust compiler internals, exact repository HEADs and actual CLI exit-code behavior still require exact-SHA inventory.
All acceptance tests remain SPECIFIED_NOT_RUN; no Run-ID/Job-ID/Step-ID or test logs are claimed.
